errors.APP_HOURLY_LIMIT: The app hit its hourly ceiling — try again later.
errors.ORG_HAS_APPS: The organization still has active apps — revoke them first.
errors.ORG_NAME_MISMATCH: The typed name does not match the organization.
errors.RECIPIENT_LIMIT_INVALID: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.HOURLY_LIMIT_INVALID: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100000.

templateIssues.VARIABLE_MISSING_SOURCE: Variable has no source — write '{{ payload.… }}' or '{{ user.… }}'.
templateIssues.VARIABLE_NOT_IN_SCHEMA: The variable is used in the content but not declared in the variable table.
templateIssues.OPTIONAL_VARIABLE_WITHOUT_DEFAULT: An optional variable needs a default value: '{{ … | default: "…" }}'.
templateIssues.FOOTER_NOT_ALLOWED: Do not write '{{ footer }}' yourself — the system inserts the footer.
templateIssues.UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_NOT_ALLOWED: Do not write an unsubscribe link yourself (not even the word "unsubscribe") — the system inserts it.
templateIssues.LINK_SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED: Links must be https:// or mailto: only.
templateIssues.USER_VARIABLE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This user.* variable is not supported yet — only '{{ user.external_id }}' exists.
templateIssues.INVALID_VARIABLE_NAME: Variable names must be payload.'<name>', using only letters, digits and underscores.
templateIssues.VARIABLE_SOURCE_MISMATCH: The variable name does not match its source.
templateIssues.VERSION_SUPERSEDED: This version has been superseded — create a new draft instead of republishing.
templateIssues.IMAGE_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Image links must be https:// and contain no variables.
templateIssues.DESIGN_TOO_LARGE: The design is too large. Shorten text or HTML blocks.
templateIssues.HTML_TAG_NOT_ALLOWED: The email contains a tag that is not allowed in email (e.g. script, iframe, form). Remove it and save again.
templateIssues.HTML_ATTRIBUTE_NOT_ALLOWED: The email contains an unsafe attribute (e.g. onclick, onerror). Remove it and save again.
templateIssues.HTML_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: There is an unsafe link (e.g. javascript:). Links may only be https://, mailto: or a variable.
templateIssues.HTML_STYLE_NOT_ALLOWED: A style contains something that is not allowed (e.g. external fonts, code in CSS).
templateIssues.HTML_MALFORMED: The email is malformed (unclosed tag / quote / comment). Fix or undo, then save again.
templateIssues.HTML_TOO_LARGE: The email is too large (max 256 KB). Remove some content.

topics.loadFailed: Could not read the topic list

recipients.errEmailTaken: This email already belongs to someone else in the app.

prefs.blockedStatus: Address is {status} — every message is blocked, even mandatory.

recipientDetail.subtitle: Recipient of {app}, registered at {at}. This screen is read-only.

validation.ipRange: IP ranges are not supported yet — enter one address at a time, e.g. 10.20.0.15
validation.ipInvalid: Must be a single IP address, e.g. 10.20.0.15

network.ipHint: The app server IP. One address at a time — ranges are not supported yet.
network.ipEmpty: None declared — EVERY IP can call.
network.loadFailed: Could not read the caller source list
network.title: IP restriction
network.subtitle: IPs allowed to call /v1 and incoming webhooks of {app}
network.limitIpBody: From now on ONLY {value} (and IPs added later) can call; others get IP_NOT_ALLOWED immediately.
network.lastIpBody: An empty list means EVERY IP can call.
network.lastIpExternal: This is an external app: add the new IP FIRST, then remove the old one.
network.lastIpLabel: Remove and open to every IP
network.removeIpBody: Servers calling from this IP get IP_NOT_ALLOWED immediately.
network.rules: With no IPs, every IP can call; once added, only listed IPs (both /v1 and incoming webhooks). Exact address match, no ranges.
network.externalNoIp: External app has no IPs — anyone with the key can call.
network.auditEmpty: No events yet (may lag a few seconds).
network.rulesShort: Only listed IPs can call; an empty list allows every IP.

credentials.subtitle: API key lifecycle of {app} · app_id never changes

credentials.emptyBody: {app} has no keys — issue the first one to call /v1.
credentials.auditEmpty: No events yet (may lag a few seconds).
credentials.issueBody: Existing keys keep working. The new key is shown exactly once.
credentials.revokeBody: Every /v1 call using this key fails immediately. This cannot be undone.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: EWS reports delivery results to {app}'s URL
webhooks.notConfiguredTitle: Webhooks are not enabled on the server
webhooks.notConfiguredBody: The server has no webhook signing key (WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY). Tell EWS operations.
webhooks.intro: EWS calls the app URL when a message has an outcome or is opened.
webhooks.howCall: POST with JSON (id, event type, outcome); reply 2xx within 10 seconds.
webhooks.howSignature: Verify the X-EWS-Signature header with the secret first.
webhooks.howRetry: On failure: retried 5 times over ~8 hours, then stops.
webhooks.howDuplicate: May arrive twice — drop duplicates by id. No email or content in the body.
webhooks.addBody: An https:// URL reachable from the internet. The secret is shown once after adding.
webhooks.editBody: Choose which events this URL receives. To change the URL, delete it and add a new one.
webhooks.eventSent: The mail server accepted the email
webhooks.eventFailed: The email could not be sent
webhooks.eventNoRecipient: Not sent because the recipient is blocked (topic off, email unsubscribed…)
webhooks.eventOpened: The recipient opened the email for the first time (needs Open tracking on)
webhooks.disableBody: EWS stops calling; pending retries are dropped and not resent on re-enable.
webhooks.rotateBody: The old secret stops working NOW — the app must switch. The new one is shown once.
webhooks.deleteBody: Stops calls and deletes pending retries and logs. Cannot be undone.
webhooks.secretBody: Shown ONCE — copy it into the app config now.
webhooks.secretUsage: The app uses it to verify the <mono>X-EWS-Signature</mono> header.
webhooks.secretSaved: I have stored the secret somewhere safe
webhooks.secretConfirmBody: Once closed it cannot be shown again; rotate to get a new one.
webhooks.hintBlocked: The URL points to a private network address — EWS does not call there.
webhooks.hintTimeout: The app did not answer within 10 seconds.
webhooks.hintConnection: Could not connect (wrong domain, server down, bad certificate…).
webhooks.hintHttp: The app answered with a non-2xx code. Check the webhook route and the signature check.
webhooks.hintOther: See the error code next to it.
webhooks.deliveriesEmpty: No calls yet. Send an email, or use Send test.
webhooks.pageSubtitle: EWS reports outcomes to the app; outside tools call in to publish.

tracking.title: Open tracking
tracking.subtitle: App {app}
tracking.hint: Estimated. Applies only to emails sent after it is turned on.
tracking.notReady: The server is not configured yet, so turning this on has no effect.

limits.title: Sending limits
limits.subtitle: App {app}
limits.windowHint: Send only on the chosen days and hours. Emails arriving outside the window are held and go out when it opens.
limits.daysDef: Days of the week when emails may be sent.
limits.hoursDef: Hours of the day when emails may be sent, Vietnam time.
limits.windowMandatoryDef: On: mandatory messages go out right away, even outside the window.
limits.pacingHint: Limits how many emails go out each minute. Emails over the limit move to the following minutes instead of going out at once.
limits.perMinuteDef: The most emails the app sends in one minute.
limits.pacingMandatoryDef: On: mandatory messages do not wait and go before regular emails.
limits.ceilingHint: The most emails the app may send per minute, for every email including mandatory ones. Set by Super Admin only.
limits.ceilingDef: "Emails per minute" under Pacing cannot exceed this number.
limits.errTime: Start time must be before end time
limits.errNumber: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}
limits.recipientHint: Each recipient gets at most this many emails per day (Vietnam time). Extra emails are skipped, not moved to the next day.
limits.perDayDef: Counts emails that passed the gates; resets at midnight Vietnam time.
limits.recipientMandatoryDef: On: mandatory emails always go and do not count.
limits.hourlyHint: Maximum emails the app may send per hour. Over it, the app gets 429 APP_HOURLY_LIMIT and retries later.
limits.perHourDef: Counted when the app submits; a topic publish that does not fit is rejected whole.
limits.hourlyMandatoryDef: On: mandatory emails are accepted even at the ceiling.

incoming.notConfigured: Webhooks are not enabled on the server.
incoming.needTopicAndTemplate: Needs an active topic and a published template.
incoming.emptyBody: Add a webhook so another system can send notifications through EWS.
incoming.needsRotation: This URL cannot be recovered — use Rotate URL.
incoming.rotateBody: The old URL stops working immediately.
incoming.deleteBody: The URL stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
incoming.callDuplicate: Same as before — not sent again
incoming.errInvalidValue: Wrong type (must be text or a number)
incoming.errBody: Body is not a JSON object '{ … }'
incoming.errRateLimited: Too many calls in one minute

systemSettings.title: System settings
systemSettings.subtitle: Operational numbers for every app — no deploy needed
systemSettings.incomingIntro: Applies to every /hooks/… URL of every app.
systemSettings.dedupeHelp: Calls without a dedupe key: identical bodies within this window publish once.
systemSettings.rateHelp: Over the limit the tool gets 429 — stops alert storms.
systemSettings.baseUrlHelp: The domain outside tools call (via NPM); the console builds full hook URLs from it. Empty = only /hooks/….
systemSettings.outOfRange: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
systemSettings.propagation: New values take effect on every API server within 30 seconds.
systemSettings.maxKeysLabel: Maximum active API keys per app
systemSettings.maxKeysHelp: At this number a key must be revoked before another is issued.
systemSettings.maxHooksHelp: At this number a hook must be deleted before another is added.
systemSettings.maxEndpointsHelp: Each URL adds one call per message. At the limit, remove one before adding.
systemSettings.htmlCheckHelp: On: HTML templates with runnable code, javascript: links, non-https images or broken HTML cannot be published. Published versions are unaffected.
systemSettings.lockoutEnabledHelp: Off = no counting, no temporary locks (existing permanent locks stay). Microsoft sign-in is never temporarily locked.
systemSettings.maxFailedHelp: This many failures for one email within the window locks it — even emails that do not exist.
systemSettings.failureWindowHelp: Counted from the first failure; if the window ends before the limit, counting starts over.
systemSettings.lockoutMinutesHelp: Lifts by itself; a Super Admin can lift it earlier in the lock table.
systemSettings.ipMaxFailedHelp: All emails from one IP added up — stops trying one password on many emails. Set high if the office shares one IP.
systemSettings.permanentAfterLabel: Lock permanently after consecutive temporary locks
systemSettings.permanentAfterHelp: After this many temporary locks in a row (24 h) the account is locked for good: Super Admin only, sessions signed out, Microsoft blocked too. 0 = never — keep 0, anyone knowing an email could lock someone out.

templateStats.sentInfo: Handed off = Microsoft 365 accepted the mail. EWS does not read bounce messages yet, so it cannot tell whether mail reached the inbox. Failed = could not hand off to Microsoft 365. Skipped = not sent because the recipient turned the topic off, the address is unusable or a limit was hit.

templateStats.chartInfo: Vietnam days. Handed off, Failed and Skipped count on the send day; opens count on the day of the first open.
